info.title: Data Collection API
info.description: This is an API to capture and publish additional data for events to be consumed by PACD

servers.description: Marriott API gateway host endpoint - Dev environment
Marriott API gateway host endpoint - Test environment

parameters.name: correlation-id
parameters.description: Correlation ID for debugging and tracking

transactionType.description: Transaction type for which event is triggering this endpoint

DataCollectionRequest.description: This entity represents meta data of a digital key.

guestDeviceId.description: Device id which use to request for digital key like mobile

lockType.description: This field will contain lock type

firmwareVersion.description: This field will contain lock Firmware Version value

rfu.description: This field will contain rfu details

message.example: The unlocking request has timed out Vendor: null Framework: null

reason.description: High level reason door did/did not unlock

voltage.description: This field will contain battery Voltage value

status.description: This field will contain battery Status value

sdkVersion.description: This field will contain Vendor Sdk Version

GuestStay.description:
This represents stay details and stay eligibilities.
For example, Expected arrival time, parking option selected by guest, currency option selected, digital check-in eligibility status, 
Mobile Key eligibility, Skip the Desk eligibility, late check-out eligibility and late check-out eligibility window allowed for this stay etc.

departureDate.description: Date when guest is checking out

ErrorResponseBadRequest.description: The encompassing array of error(s) that can be returned when an issue occurs while requesting a Resource via API.

code.description: The error code of this particular error that can be used to uniquely identify what went wrong with the request.

message.description: The message associated with the error code that was returned that provides more details describing the actual error.

source.description: The optionally provided source of the error i.e. the Amadeus webservice name, the name of the system/service returning the error, etc.

timestamp.description: The time of which the error occurred.

path.description: The path associated with the generated error.
